newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Pineapple in huge land projects.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Pineapple in huge land projects.

text.p: Taiwan Pineapple Co said on Tuesday it would invest up to T$6 billion to build a university, hospital, shopping malls and vacation centres over eight years on four parcels of land it owns in central and southern Taiwan.
"We plan to utilise our land to complete the four projects between 1997 and 2004," a Pineapple executive told Reuters, adding that the projects were expected to cost the company some T$5-6 billion.
"But we should be able to earn a profit of over T$50 billion through these projects," he said.
The plan includes a luxury villa and a shopping mall in Yuanlin city in central Taiwan and a vacation centre and tourist hotel in southern Pingtung city.
It also includes a university, a hospital and a large shopping mall to be built in a new town in Pingtung county as well as a recreation centre in central Changhua city.
The food company, which expects 1997 sales to reach T$2.6 billion, has also invested in food businesses in Indonesia.
